items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: Jelly Roll had a band. Yeah, the fellow named... Was playing trumpet by the name of Melton. Vernon Melton on trumpet.

ctx.x: Who was in Jelly Roll's band? I'm... Bill Russell's real interested in Jelly Roll, so I thought I'd ask you about it. But Russell wants to know all he can about Jelly Roll.
Well, I tell you, Jelly Roll had a band. Yeah, the fellow named... Was playing trumpet by the name of Melton.
